cleanup: No compiler, runtime, native or capture process started; none owed.
cutoff_requirements: Assign the irreversible cutoff flag before taking any pre-cutoff signal snapshot.
A handler chooses pre/post classification from cutoff state at handler observation, then records and returns in all phases.
Every pre-cutoff handler observation rejects; no late handler may append to the frozen pre-cutoff set.
No compiler, hash or parser work follows cutoff; cutoff time is the explicit finite observation endpoint.
Post-cutoff signals are outside completed observation and are never promised in receipt snapshots.
No inherited blocked signal mask or preexec action is introduced.
Observation publication failure cannot leave a completed accepted receipt.
Producer controls are retained evidence to read, not replay; fresh independent synthetic models are not actual compiler qualification.

execution_contract.cleanup: Capture/hash outputs; stop/wait/reap only owned compiler child; hash/remove any owned metadata/temp outputs after custody; never global process inventory.

independent_review_cases.expect: Record and return; successful constructor handle retained; eventual cleanup closes only that owned child; pre-cutoff request rejects.
Pre-cutoff request rejects; no invented handle; constructor failure retained; no claim that a never-retained child was closed.
independent_review_cases.inject: Constructor raises after a handled signal

independent_review_cases.expect: Record and return without interrupting cleanup; preserve child handle and exact closure evidence; pre-cutoff request rejects.
independent_review_cases.inject: During owned cleanup or its wait

independent_review_cases.expect: Record and return; request belongs to pre-cutoff set and rejects even if cleanup/hash/parser later succeeds.
independent_review_cases.inject: After cleanup and before posthash or diagnostic parsing completes

independent_review_cases.expect: Handler observes cutoff incomplete; observation belongs to pre-cutoff set; accepted receipt is forbidden.
Handler observes cutoff complete; record only as outside completed observation; do not insert into frozen pre-cutoff set or retroactively reject.
independent_review_cases.inject: Between one-way cutoff assignment and pre-cutoff snapshot

independent_review_cases.expect: Same post-cutoff semantics; no further compiler/hash/parser work; final evidence expressly limits signal coverage to cutoff.
independent_review_cases.inject: After pre-cutoff snapshot and before observation write

independent_review_cases.expect: Post-cutoff record and return; accepted receipt may follow only after observation write succeeds; no promise that late record is in published snapshot.
Post-cutoff record and return; published observation already exists; receipt explicitly covers only pre-cutoff handler observations.
Final accepted receipt must not be published; retained failure may coexist with partial observation bytes but never a completed accepted receipt.
Observation retained; no successfully completed accepted receipt is claimed by the runner.

required_order: compiler child and owned group closure
